nodes.name: DODAC-templated Pd-B alloy synthesis
nodes.procedure: DODAC is composed of two long hydrophobic tails that first self-assemble with Pd precursors (PdCl₄²⁻) to form chemically stable PdCl₄²⁻/DODAC hybrids with a cylindrical mesophase. Strong hydrophobicity of DODAC inhibits the mobility of Pd precursors in the PdCl₄²⁻/DODAC hybrids and confines in situ nucleation and growth of Pd-B alloy nanocrystals along the cylindrical mesophase. After the removal of DODAC, mesoporous Pd-B alloy nanoparticles with dendritic center-radial mesochannels are obtained.
nodes.source_text: our group reported a new amphiphilic surfactant, dioctadecyldimethylammonium chloride (DODAC), that templated the synthesis of mesoporous Pd-B alloy nanoparticles (Figure 2a).

nodes.name: Concurrent template Pd-B phase engineering
nodes.procedure: We thus designed a concurrent template that combines a mesoporous silica template (KIT-6) and a mesoporous Pd seed (defined as mesoPd/KIT-6) to explore how B changes the crystalline structures of Pd-B alloys at the atomic level while retaining mesoporous structure at the mesoscopic level (Figure 2f). The key to our success was the utilization of mesoPd/KIT-6 as the concurrent template in which metallic Pd as the seed drives the phase evolution from fcc-Pd to fcc-Pd₅B to hcp-Pd₂B, while mesoporous KIT-6 as the hard template confines phase evolution within a mesoporous framework.
nodes.source_text: mesoPd/KIT-6 as the concurrent template in which metallic Pd as the seed drives the phase evolution from fcc-Pd to fcc-Pd₅B to hcp-Pd₂B, while mesoporous KIT-6 as the hard template confines phase evolution within a mesoporous framework (Figure 2f).

nodes.name: In situ PtPdNiP alloy formation
nodes.procedure: As-synthesized mesoporous PtPd was used as the seed to synthesize mesoporous PtPdNiP alloy nanoparticles in situ in the presence of NiCl₂ (Ni source), NaH₂PO₂ (P source), and NaBH₄ (reducing agent). With coreduction of NiP, mesoporous PtPd recrystallized and further grew with Ni and P to form quaternary mesoporous PtPdNiP alloys. Pluronic F127 (PEO₁₀₀PPO₆₅PEO₁₀₀) micelles behave as the mesopore-forming agent.
nodes.source_text: as-synthesized mesoporous PtPd was used as the seed to synthesize mesoporous PtPdNiP alloy nanoparticles in situ in the presence of NiCl₂ (Ni source), NaH₂PO₂ (P source), and NaBH₄ (reducing agent) (Figure 3a).

nodes.name: Post-treatment PtPdSP alloy nanocages
nodes.procedure: First synthesized h-mesoPtPd nanocages with SiO₂ nanoparticles as the hollow cavity-forming template and F127 as the mesopore-forming agent. After being treated with triphenylphosphine sulphide (P and S source), h-mesoPtPdSP alloy nanocages were prepared accordingly.
nodes.source_text: After being treated with triphenylphosphine sulphide (P and S source), h-mesoPtPdSP alloy nanocages were prepared accordingly.

nodes.name: DODAC-templated ternary PdBP synthesis
nodes.procedure: In 2019, our group reported a simple in situ reduction and nucleation of synthesizing ternary PdBP alloys along a columnar mesophase assembled by strong hydrophobic DODAC (Figure 4a). Similar to mesoporous Pd-B alloys, coassembly of DODAC and PdCl₄²⁻ results in the formation of chemically stable columnar DODAC/PdCl₄²⁻ hybrids. After the addition of DMAB (B source) and NaH₂PO₂ (P source), in situ reduction of Pd with B and P causes targeted nucleation of ternary mesoporous PdBP alloys confined in the columnar mesophase.
nodes.source_text: simple in situ reduction and nucleation of synthesizing ternary PdBP alloys along a columnar mesophase assembled by strong hydrophobic DODAC (Figure 4a).

nodes.name: Kirkendall hollow mesoporous PdS synthesis
nodes.procedure: Our group recently developed a new synthetic strategy by taking advantage of Kirkendall cavitation and hard template synthesis to prepare h-mesoPdS alloy nanoparticles using mesoPd/KIT-6 as the concurrent template (Figure 3g). Because the diffusion of Pd is faster than the infusion of S, the Kirkendall effect causes cavitation of mesoporous PdS alloys in a confined KIT-6 template. Physical separation between reactive Pd and S by the hard KIT-6 template also simplified the synthesis through a direct solid-phase route.
nodes.source_text: taking advantage of Kirkendall cavitation and hard template synthesis to prepare h-mesoPdS alloy nanoparticles using mesoPd/KIT-6 as the concurrent template (Figure 3g).

nodes.name: PdBS alloy nanoparticles synthesis
nodes.procedure: By substituting NaH₂PO₂ (P source) with Na₂S₂O₃ (S source), mesoporous PdBS alloy nanoparticles with a tunable S content in the range of 0-28% are obtained.
nodes.source_text: By substituting NaH₂PO₂ (P source) with Na₂S₂O₃ (S source), mesoporous PdBS alloy nanoparticles with a tunable S content in the range of 0-28% are obtained.

nodes.name: Postalloying RhBS alloy film
nodes.procedure: By using mesoporous Rh films as the seed template, reported a post-treatment route to synthesize mesoporous RhBS alloy films in the presence of NaBH₄ (B source) and Na₂SO₃ (S source).
nodes.source_text: By using mesoporous Rh films as the seed template, reported a post-treatment route to synthesize mesoporous RhBS alloy films in the presence of NaBH₄ (B source) and Na₂SO₃ (S source) (Figure 4l).
